answers.question: (2) What does anthropic 1.11.0 measure on this pin: exception hierarchy and status mapping, default retries/timeout and retry policy, messages.create signature for text+image blocks, structured-output options, usage field names, Model literal?
answers.answer: EXCEPTIONS (_exceptions.py): AnthropicError > APIError(message, request, body) > APIStatusError(status_code, request_id, workspace_id, type: ErrorType|None read from body['error']['type']) with subclasses BadRequestError 400, AuthenticationError 401, PermissionDeniedError 403, NotFoundError 404, ConflictError 409, RequestTooLargeError 413, UnprocessableEntityError 422, RateLimitError 429, ServiceUnavailableError 503, DeadlineExceededError 504, OverloadedError 529, InternalServerError (no literal); APIConnectionError > APITimeoutError (siblings of APIStatusError, not subclasses); APIResponseValidationError; plus RetryableError and CredentialsError > IdentityTokenFileError directly under AnthropicError. The client's _make_status_error constructs 400/401/403/404/409/413/422/429/529 explicitly and then `>= 500` -> InternalServerError, so 503 and 504 are NEVER raised as ServiceUnavailableError/DeadlineExceededError (they arrive as InternalServerError), and a 402 billing_error has no class at all (bare APIStatusError, status_code 402, .type 'billing_error'). ErrorType literal: invalid_request_error, authentication_error, permission_error, not_found_error, rate_limit_error, timeout_error, overloaded_error, api_error, billing_error. DEFAULTS (_constants.py): DEFAULT_TIMEOUT = 10 min (connect 5.0 s), DEFAULT_MAX_RETRIES = 2, INITIAL_RETRY_DELAY 0.5 s, MAX_RETRY_DELAY 8.0 s. RETRY POLICY (_base_client.py): `x-should-retry` header overrides; otherwise retries 408, 409, 429 and every status >= 500 (529 included), plus APIConnectionError/APITimeoutError and RetryableError (walking __cause__); 400/401/402/403/404/413/422 are not retried. The sleep honours `retry-after-ms` / `retry-after` VERBATIM (cap 4,294,967 s, i.e. effectively uncapped), else 0.5*2^n with jitter capped at 8 s, so SDK wall time is unbounded by retry-after unless the caller bounds it. Non-streaming create/parse with the default client timeout computes a timeout and RAISES ValueError ('Streaming is required...') when 3600*max_tokens/128000 > 600, i.e. max_tokens > 21,333; the app's limits (<= 1000) are far below. CLIENT: AsyncAnthropic(api_key=None, auth_token=None, credentials=None, config=None, profile=None, webhook_key=None, base_url=None, timeout=not_given, max_retries=2, ...); with api_key None it resolves ANTHROPIC_API_KEY, then ANTHROPIC_AUTH_TOKEN, then an `ant auth login` profile, so a bare client can authenticate WITHOUT the env var: the adapter must pass api_key explicitly and gate on the env name alone. MESSAGES.CREATE (keyword-only): required max_tokens: int, messages: Iterable[MessageParam], model: ModelParam; optional cache_control, container, diagnostics, inference_geo, metadata, output_config, service_tier ('auto'|'standard_only'), stop_sequences, stream, system: str | Iterable[TextBlockParam], thinking, tool_choice, tools, user_profile_id, workspace_id; plus extra_headers/extra_query/extra_body/timeout. ZERO occurrences of temperature/top_p/top_k in message_create_params.py or messages.py, and no `store` kwarg: forwarding model_config.sampling_kwargs output or the U3c store=False raises TypeError at the SDK boundary (before any 400). MessageParam role Literal user|assistant|system; content str or blocks: {'type':'text','text':...} (TextBlockParam, optional cache_control/citations) and {'type':'image','source': Base64ImageSourceParam {'type':'base64','media_type': 'image/jpeg'|'image/png'|'image/gif'|'image/webp','data': b64} | URLImageSourceParam {'type':'url','url'} | FileImageSourceParam} (ImageBlockParam, optional transformations). HEIC is not a legal media_type; image_routes already rejects HEIC with a 400 and accepts exactly jpeg/png/webp/gif, so the camera input matches. STRUCTURED OUTPUT: output_config={'effort': 'low'|'medium'|'high'|'xhigh'|'max', 'format': {'type':'json_schema','schema': {...}}} (OutputConfigParam / JSONOutputFormatParam); tools=[ToolParam{name, input_schema{type:'object', properties, required; extra keys allowed}, description, strict: bool, cache_control, defer_loading, eager_input_streaming, allowed_callers}]; messages.parse(..., output_format=<pydantic type>) -> ParsedMessage exists (sync :1178, async :2659). thinking: Union[adaptive{display summarized|omitted}, enabled{budget_tokens, display}, disabled, between_tools]; the SDK itself only warns for 'enabled' on claude-opus-4-6/mythos-preview. RESPONSE: Message.stop_reason Literal end_turn|max_tokens|stop_sequence|tool_use|pause_turn|refusal|model_context_window_exceeded; stop_details RefusalStopDetails{type 'refusal', category cyber|bio|frontier_llm|reasoning_extraction|general_harms|None, explanation}. USAGE (types/usage.py): input_tokens: int, output_tokens: int (required), cache_creation_input_tokens, cache_read_input_tokens, cache_creation (CacheCreation by TTL), output_tokens_details, server_tool_use, service_tier ('standard'|'priority'|'batch'), inference_geo. MODEL LITERAL (types/model.py = model_param.py): claude-sonnet-5-5, claude-fable-5-1, claude-opus-5-5, claude-mythos-5-1, claude-sonnet-5, claude-fable-5, claude-mythos-5, claude-opus-5, claude-opus-4-8, claude-opus-4-7, claude-mythos-preview, claude-opus-4-6, claude-sonnet-4-6, claude-haiku-4-5, claude-haiku-4-5-20251001, claude-opus-4-5, claude-opus-4-5-20251101, claude-sonnet-4-5, claude-sonnet-4-5-20250929, unioned with `str`. Of the four asked: claude-opus-5-5 YES, claude-sonnet-5-5 YES, claude-fable-5-1 YES, claude-haiku-5-5 NO (zero occurrences anywhere in the installed package); the `str` arm means the id is still sent unchanged, but its acceptance by the API is not measurable offline (the claude-api skill table, cached 2026-10-06, lists claude-haiku-5-5 at $0.10/$0.50 per MTok). SENTRY SIDE EFFECT (measured on the pinned sentry-sdk 2.68.1): AnthropicIntegration is in _AUTO_ENABLING_INTEGRATIONS and activates whenever anthropic>=0.16 is importable, with include_prompts=True by default; sentry_service.init passes only integrations= (auto_enabling_integrations stays True), so the lock bump ALONE adds 'AnthropicIntegration' to the init list and reddens the SR8 pin test_u8d_pin_integration_list_unchanged. Prompt capture is additionally gated by send_default_pii (pinned False), so no prompt would leave, but the pin goes red regardless.

answers.question: (3) Where does the checkout name OpenAI as the only AI processor, and which pins and manifests freeze that today?
answers.answer: OpenAI is the only AI processor named in all four legal documents, in the consent copy (EN+AR), and in the processor manifest; the words 'anthropic' and 'claude' occur nowhere in app/legal, app/ (other than a comment at openai_service.py:69) or the client source. Privacy policy EN names OpenAI at lines 15, 28, 38, 55, 58, 63 (section 4 heading 'Comparisons made with AI (OpenAI)'), 65, 67, 69, 75 ('- **OpenAI:** identifies products and writes comparisons'), 87, 109; the AR twin at the same twelve line numbers. Terms EN 53 ('Our AI provider is OpenAI') and 91; AR 53 and 91. Consent copy: en.json 703-707 (aiConsent.title/body/link/agree/notNow; the body at :704 names OpenAI twice) and the onboarding Step 5 twins at :574-575 'What reaches OpenAI'; ar.json :700-704 (body :701 names OpenAI twice) and :571-572. That copy is frozen by aiConsent.ts:46 AI_CONSENT_VERSION = 2 and the sha256 fence 372c5048... over the EN+AR strings in __tests__/consent/aiConsentVersion.s69.test.ts:36 (a wording change re-pins the hash and bumps the version, which re-asks every user, UB-R14). Manifest: app/legal/processors.json has 18 rows; the `openai` row (lines 56-76) is the only AI processor: kind processor, module = 7 files (openai_service, extraction_service, url_extraction_service, llm_provider, verdict_critique_service, content_safety_service, image_service), hosts ['api.openai.com'], gate_flag null, category 'OpenAI', public_name true; public_name is true only for openai/apple/google_sign_in/retailers. Freezes: test_legal_s78.py:897-921 test_s78_r22_manifest_categories requires the row-id set to equal tests/fixtures/legal_s78.json manifest_base (18 ids) and each row's kind/module/hosts/gate_flag/personal_data to equal the frozen values, so adding an `anthropic` row OR adding app/services/llm_adapter.py to the openai module list reddens R22 unless the fixture is re-recorded. T7b (test_legal_docs_u8.py:1039-1058) scans app/services/**/*.py for http(s) URL literals outside docstrings (first-party qaren.app/getmyez.com and loopback excluded) and for the constructor names {AsyncOpenAI, OpenAI, create_client, Redis, StrictRedis} + redis.from_url + sentry_sdk.init; every module with a hit must be in a row's module list and every host covered by that row's hosts, else 'unmapped'. Consequence: a literal 'https://api.anthropic.com' in the adapter trips T7b as unmapped, but an adapter that constructs AsyncAnthropic(...) with NO URL literal is INVISIBLE to T7b today (AsyncAnthropic is not in CLIENT_CONSTRUCTORS; 'anthropic' occurs 0 times in both legal test files). Moderation stays on OpenAI at content_safety_service.py:249-252 (client.moderations.create via openai_service.get_client). The OpenAI failure classifier the adapter mirrors is api_budget_service._openai_failure_is_transient (:907-932: RateLimitError, APIConnectionError, InternalServerError and status >= 500 are transient; 4xx other than 429 is a request defect, :893-904), and LLMUnavailableError (:702-709) whose message must avoid '429'/'rate'/'quota' because extraction_service.generate_comparison substring-matches them for its fallback. Cost recording reads usage.prompt_tokens/completion_tokens (openai_pricing.py:135-137), so Anthropic input_tokens/output_tokens would record unpriced unless normalised; openai_service.py:69 already mentions Anthropic-style flat usage in a comment.

answers.question: (4) B10 ruling: the pin, the exception mapping the adapter must implement, and the exact pins/manifests the placeholder must leave untouched vs extend.
answers.ruling_text:
RULING B10-R0 (Anthropic placeholder prerequisites; everything measured on anthropic 1.11.0 and sentry-sdk 2.68.1 installed in a scratch venv, no live Anthropic call).

1. PIN. `anthropic==1.11.0` (PyPI upload 2026-09-30T22:58:22Z, 18 days old on 2026-10-19; 1.12.0+ are younger than 14 days). Declare the exact line in requirements.in and recompile requirements.txt then requirements-dev.txt (-c requirements.txt, --universal, --python-version 3.12). Lock impact: httpx2 (lock 2.12.0 via openai) already satisfies httpx2>=2.0,<3; anyio/jiter/pydantic/sniffio/typing-extensions already satisfy; ONE new transitive, docstring-parser>=0.15,<1. CI `Lock is current` and `pip-audit --strict` must pass on the recompiled lock (not run here). The SDK is built on httpx2, not httpx: never pass an httpx.Timeout/Client object to it.

2. EXCEPTION MAPPING the adapter implements (classify on status_code AND exc.type, never on message text; the SDK exposes APIStatusError.type parsed from body.error.type):
   TRANSIENT (counts toward the openai-style breaker, may be retried within the app's own deadline): anthropic.RateLimitError (429, type rate_limit_error), anthropic.OverloadedError (529, overloaded_error), anthropic.InternalServerError (every other >= 500 incl. 500 api_error, 502/503/504 -- the client never constructs ServiceUnavailableError/DeadlineExceededError, so do not catch those two by class), anthropic.APIConnectionError and its subclass APITimeoutError, and asyncio TimeoutError from the adapter's own wait_for.
